name: Intertrochanteric Hip Fracture
definition: Extracapsular fracture through the intertrochanteric region of the proximal femur, usually following a low-energy fall in older adults.

investigations.MRI: MRI for occult fracture if radiographs are negative and suspicion persists.
investigations.radiographs: AP pelvis and lateral hip radiographs are first-line.

amber: Implant choice depends on fracture pattern and stability.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna rehabilitation may be considered only after modern fixation/stability management.

patientEducation.summary: Extracapsular fracture through the intertrochanteric region of the proximal femur, usually following a low-energy fall in older adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Management of Hip Fractures in Older Adults
